ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Didn't authorise transaction"), OR( ISBLANK(Customer_Description__c), ISPICKVAL(Card_In_Possession_During_Transaction__c,''), ISPICKVAL(Has_The_Card_Been_Stopped__c,'') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Customer Description, Card In Possession During Transaction, Has The Card Been Stopped.
